primary_data.source: Kenneth R. French Data Library historical archives
primary_data.common_sample_rule: intersection of monthly dates present in both factor and six-portfolio files across both snapshots

secondary_data.source: Aswath Damodaran / NYU Stern industry datasets
secondary_data.vintage: January 2026 / current archived retrieval in executable package

inference.multiplicity: Benjamini-Hochberg FDR on pre-specified revision-test family

attribution_rule: Observed differences are archive/construction-regime sensitivity. No pure causal FIZ-to-CIZ attribution without additional decomposition.
search_rule: No p-value-driven specification selection. Search/evolution uses frozen scientific fitness and validation separation.
